title: Why Saquon Barkley is ‘super excited' to play for new Eagles OC Sean Mannion

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Why Saquon Barkley is ‘super excited' to play for new Eagles OC Sean Mannion
sources.description: After living through one year of Kevin Patullo’s offense, Saquon Barkley loves what he sees so far from Sean Mannion’s scheme.
